research_history_boundary.claim_scope: source-seen successor candidate, not a pristine discovery or market holdout
research_history_boundary.design_origin: IVLIR-72 was rejected because cumulative-flow levels produced a 26-event same-side run; IVFHR makes a state transition the event rather than adding an anti-persistence gate to the rejected identity

mechanism.name: intrinsic-volume flow handoff relay
mechanism.economic_object: after at least three consecutive eligible equal-notional daily anchors share one cumulative taker-flow sign, the first strong opposite-sign anchor is a transfer of aggressive inventory control; if price from the UTC-day open still points against the new flow, trade the new flow for delayed catch-up
new_geometry: a sign transition after a completed persistent source state is the event
current price non-confirmation is required before following the new flow
one event per transition episode rather than repeated level-triggered entries
explicitly_not: a backward rolling volume-clock jump gate
an LLM-generated side, threshold, entry, exit, or hold

source_contract.timestamp_semantics: date is the Binance bar-open timestamp in UTC; a row stamped t covers [t,t+5min) and becomes decision-available only at t+5min
source_contract.missing_bar_policy: fail closed; no interpolation or forward fill

causal_feature_contract.daily_expected_volume: median total quote_asset_volume of the previous 28 complete UTC days; current day excluded; at least 21 complete days required
causal_feature_contract.anchor: first completed five-minute bar of the UTC day whose cumulative quote volume reaches the target; its date is the bar-open timestamp; reject anchors whose bar-open timestamp is after 17:55 UTC
causal_feature_contract.cumulative_flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume) from UTC-day start through the anchor divided by cumulative quote volume over the same bars
causal_feature_contract.flow_side: LONG when cumulative_flow>0; SHORT when cumulative_flow<0
causal_feature_contract.invalid_anchor: a missing/incomplete UTC day, target not reached by the 17:55-open bar, non-finite required value, non-positive cumulative volume, or exactly zero cumulative flow is state-invalid; it emits no anchor, is excluded from the event reference, and resets the prior-state run
causal_feature_contract.prior_state: the immediately preceding calendar-consecutive run of valid daily anchors with one flow_side; it must contain at least three anchors; invalid or ineligible calendar days break rather than skip the run
causal_feature_contract.handoff: current flow_side differs from the immediately preceding eligible anchor; only the first anchor after that completed prior state can qualify
causal_feature_contract.event_reference: previous 180 eligible daily anchors, excluding current; at least 90 required; NumPy linear quantile without clipping or winsorization
causal_feature_contract.strong_new_flow: abs(current cumulative_flow) >= q60 absolute cumulative flow from the strictly-prior event reference
causal_feature_contract.price_lag: new_flow_sign * log(anchor_close / UTC-day first-bar open) <= 0; price has not yet confirmed the new aggressive-flow side
causal_feature_contract.side: fixed to the current/new cumulative-flow sign

execution_contract.decision: for anchor bar-open timestamp t, after [t,t+5min) closes at t+5min
execution_contract.cagr: full declared calendar including warmup and idle cash
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM with entry cost, exact funding, every held-bar favorable-then-adverse path, virtual adverse exit cost, and actual exit

statistic_definitions.calendar_subperiod: entry_time membership with exit_time <= subperiod end
statistic_definitions.side_share: side count divided by accepted events in the named window
statistic_definitions.active_months: distinct UTC calendar months containing an accepted entry
statistic_definitions.month_or_quarter_share: accepted entries in the UTC month or quarter divided by all accepted primary entries across train plus selection
statistic_definitions.calendar_gap_days: maximum elapsed days between consecutive accepted primary entry_time values; warmup/source endpoints are excluded
statistic_definitions.same_side_run: maximum chronological run of equal side among accepted primary entries

source_support_gate.failure_action: reject without calculating a post-entry return
source_support_gate.gate_domain: the chronologically accepted, split-contained, non-overlapping primary clock after signal construction; train/selection and calendar subwindows use entry_time containment and require exit_time <= window end

source_only_controls.exact_side_flip: same primary timestamps with the old/prior flow side; report-only
source_only_controls.any_handoff: drop prior-state length and current-flow-strength requirements; retain price lag; report-only
source_only_controls.no_price_lag: retain persistent-state handoff and strong new flow; drop price-lag gate; report-only
source_only_controls.no_flow_strength: retain persistent-state handoff and price lag; drop current q60 gate; report-only
source_only_controls.persistence_level: same persistent prior state, strong current flow, and price lag, but require no sign change; report-only
source_only_controls.fixed_noon_handoff: replace first-passage anchor by the 11:55-open bar, require the intrinsic target to have been reached by that bar, and preserve strictly-prior expected volume, state, and reference calculations; report-only
source_only_controls.deterministic_random_side: primary timestamps with NumPy default_rng seed from SHA256('IVFHR-72|side'); report-only
source_only_controls.shared_control_contract: any_handoff, no_price_lag, no_flow_strength, and persistence_level require the same 90-anchor strictly-prior reference warmup as primary even when a control drops the q60 test; fixed_noon_handoff builds its own identical strictly-prior warmup; exact_side_flip and deterministic_random_side reuse primary timestamps exactly; every control uses the same next-open latency, 72-bar hold, chronological non-overlap, split containment, and clock-only schema as primary; malformed control clocks fail the build, but control incidence cannot rescue or reject a primary source-support decision

strict_sequence.phase_2: hash-freeze strict evaluator before any post-entry outcome
strict_sequence.phase_4: open selection 2023 only if train passes

economic_gates.component_margin_statistic: primary mean gross underlying basis points minus the maximum mean gross underlying basis points among the frozen component_control_universe, measured within the same opened stage before leverage, funding, or transaction cost

llm_boundary.reason: the LLM is reserved for symbolic context arbitration after the event itself shows causal economic edge; it cannot rescue a failed base event
